newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling eases vs dollar in rangebound trade.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling eases vs dollar in rangebound trade.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling eased marginally against the dollar in range-bound trade, commercial bank dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 53.91 against the dollar compared to 53.90 on Thursday while against the pound, the shilling was posted at a mean rate of 87.40 from 87.41.
Dealers said the market was matched and that it appeared to have stabilised.
"Most players are squaring positions ahead of the weekend. We don't expect anything new today (Friday), so rates might just hold steady," one dealer said.
The money market remained tight with overnight rates quoted above 20 percent from 20 percent on Thursday.
